external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Our review team has examined thousands of hours of EM data for a range of fisheries, capturing data for catch accounting, compliance monitoring, and protected species interactions. In addition to review and reporting, our services include reviewer training, data analysis and audit services. At Saltwater, we believe that open source review software benefits our clients by avoiding the limitations and expense associated with proprietary software.
